additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case ID0451679 ﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue. The first response has been sent to the customer, and we kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer: SMEG
Product: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset: Y2/R9 313202799057
Charger ID / Serial No.:
sX0Otz
Charger address/functional location: Monaco 89600 - Saint Florentin
Priority: Medium
Possible solution: Please proceed with the replacement of the HMI. Here are the MLFBs:
8EM5902-1AA00-6AA1 - Controlpanel RAFI 3 segments w/o AC cutout
8EM5902-1AA02-0AA8 - Controlp. RAFI middle segm. contactl. CCR
8EM5905-0AA00-8AA6 - Controlpanel Adaptation Set DLogic Gen1 → RAFI
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require expert support, kindly create Work-order as per unified service process. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at afonso-sousa@siemens.com or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at rui.teodoso@siemens.com.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team – Calin Ienei
